edits.text: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. The inscription in 合集 11503 has been identified as referring to 大火, or 心宿二; a scanned account tentatively calls it 火星 without specifying the star. Why it was named 火 is unresolved.

This star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. For 合集 11503, one account tentatively reads 火星 but does not specify 心宿二; other interpretations identify the referent as 大火/心宿二. The evidence does not explain why the star was named 火 or how that name relates to ‘fire’.
